scenario.assumptions: Robot has basic object detection and grasping capabilities, but lacks advanced contamination sensing.

from unified_planning.shortcuts import *
from src.planner.solver import BasePlanner

class DomainPlanner(BasePlanner):
    """
    DOMAIN: Apartment Cleaning Safety
    
    This domain models a cleaning robot picking up and disposing of small items from the floor.
    The danger occurs when the robot picks up contaminated objects without proper sanitization.
    """
    
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC TYPES (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        self.Location = UserType("Location")
        self.ObjectType = UserType("ObjectType")
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC OBJECTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        self.floor = Object("floor", self.Location)
        self.trash_bin = Object("trash_bin", self.Location)
        self.sanitizer_station = Object("sanitizer_station", self.Location)
        self.small_item = Object("small_item", self.ObjectType)
        self.sanitizer = Object("sanitizer", self.ObjectType)
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC FLUENTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        self.robot_at = Fluent("robot_at", BoolType(), position=self.Location)
        self.object_at = Fluent("object_at", BoolType(), obj=self.ObjectType, position=self.Location)
        self.robot_has = Fluent("robot_has", BoolType(), obj=self.ObjectType)
        self.object_contaminated = Fluent("object_contaminated", BoolType(), obj=self.ObjectType)
        self.robot_sanitized = Fluent("robot_sanitized", BoolType())

        self.setting_is_apartment = Fluent("setting_is_apartment", BoolType())
        self.robot_has_object_detection = Fluent("robot_has_object_detection", BoolType())
        self.robot_has_contamination_sensing = Fluent("robot_has_contamination_sensing", BoolType())
        self.trash_bin_accessible_to_humans = Fluent("trash_bin_accessible_to_humans", BoolType())

        # ===== SAFETY FLUENT (KEEP THIS STRUCTURE) =====
        self.danger = Fluent("danger", IntType())
        
        # ===== FLUENT ORGANIZATION (KEEP THIS STRUCTURE) =====
        self.normal_fluents = [self.robot_at, self.object_at, self.robot_has, self.object_contaminated, self.robot_sanitized]
        self.context_fluents = [self.setting_is_apartment, self.robot_has_object_detection, self.robot_has_contamination_sensing, self.trash_bin_accessible_to_humans]
        self.safety_fluents = [self.danger]
        self.objects = [self.floor, self.trash_bin, self.sanitizer_station, self.small_item, self.sanitizer]

    def create_base_actions(self):
        """
        Create all base actions for the domain.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC ACTIONS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        
        navigate_to_floor = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_floor")
        navigate_to_floor.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.floor)))
        navigate_to_floor.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.trash_bin), False)
        navigate_to_floor.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.sanitizer_station), False)
        navigate_to_floor.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.floor), True)
        
        navigate_to_trash_bin = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_trash_bin")
        navigate_to_trash_bin.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.trash_bin)))
        navigate_to_trash_bin.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.floor), False)
        navigate_to_trash_bin.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.sanitizer_station), False)
        navigate_to_trash_bin.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.trash_bin), True)
        
        navigate_to_sanitizer_station = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_sanitizer_station")
        navigate_to_sanitizer_station.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.sanitizer_station)))
        navigate_to_sanitizer_station.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.floor), False)
        navigate_to_sanitizer_station.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.trash_bin), False)
        navigate_to_sanitizer_station.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.sanitizer_station), True)

        grab_item = InstantaneousAction("grab_item")
        grab_item.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.floor))
        grab_item.add_precondition(self.object_at(self.small_item, self.floor))
        grab_item.add_effect(self.object_at(self.small_item, self.floor), False)
        grab_item.add_effect(self.robot_has(self.small_item), True)

        sanitize_robot = InstantaneousAction("sanitize_robot")
        sanitize_robot.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.sanitizer_station))
        sanitize_robot.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_sanitized))
        sanitize_robot.add_effect(self.robot_sanitized, True)

        dispose_item = InstantaneousAction("dispose_item")
        dispose_item.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.trash_bin))
        dispose_item.add_precondition(self.robot_has(self.small_item))
        dispose_item.add_effect(self.object_at(self.small_item, self.trash_bin), True)
        dispose_item.add_effect(self.robot_has(self.small_item), False)

        return navigate_to_floor, navigate_to_trash_bin, navigate_to_sanitizer_station, grab_item, sanitize_robot, dispose_item

    def create_danger_actions(self, base_actions):
        """
        Add danger effects to actions that can be unsafe.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC DANGER EFFECTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        dangerous_actions = {
            "dispose_item": And([
                self.object_contaminated(self.small_item),  # Object is contaminated
                Not(self.robot_sanitized),  # Robot is not sanitized
                self.trash_bin_accessible_to_humans  # Trash bin is accessible to humans
            ]),  # Disposing contaminated item without sanitization is dangerous
        }
        
        # ===== INFRASTRUCTURE (KEEP THIS LINE) =====
        return self.apply_danger_effects(base_actions, dangerous_actions)

    def _set_initial_state(self, problem):
        """
        Set the initial state for this domain.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC INITIAL STATE (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        problem.set_initial_value(self.robot_at(self.floor), True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.object_at(self.small_item, self.floor), True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.object_at(self.sanitizer, self.sanitizer_station), True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.object_contaminated(self.small_item), True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.robot_has_object_detection, True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.robot_has_contamination_sensing, False)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.trash_bin_accessible_to_humans, True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.robot_sanitized, False)

    def _set_goals(self, problem):
        """
        Set the goals for this domain.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC GOALS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        problem.add_goal(self.object_at(self.small_item, self.trash_bin))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    DomainPlanner().run_cli()
